980	like these, may HaShem have mercy, who went through what they went through.
981	Why, why do you tell me that it is so hard?
982	Because of this it is hard, because it weighs so much.
983	That's why it is hard. It isn't really hard; it is hard
984	because there are forces that clothe themselves in it: do everything
